name: folio-atlas
description: Turn Downloads into a map of your work. Learn local project vocabulary, sort and refresh without deleting files, browse by date or size, and optionally verify a Google Drive backup before explicit local cleanup.

interface.longDescription: Three local agent workflows: Sort learns each user's selected projects and organizes confident matches by project and other files by type/subject; Refresh reuses the private schema for new arrivals; Archive is explicit-only and verifies a genuine cloud download and full SHA256 restore before separately authorized local cleanup. Includes a portable HTML browser with date and size controls. Python 3.10+ and local filesystem access are required. Core scripts are offline; cloud transfers use the user's separately available connector or browser. No personal profiles, credentials, watchers, or hooks are included.
defaultPrompt: Use Folio Sort to learn my projects and organize Downloads without deleting anything.
Use Folio Refresh to sort my new downloads using my saved schema.
